question: At the live descriptor geometry, can one locally started CPU/HF service record the one-to-eight-session screening matrix and sustain its largest passing bound for ten minutes while retaining session-local backpressure and text isolation through overload and observer reconnect?

may_establish: G5 cross-session text isolation through overload and observer reconnect
G4 non-GPU duration, round-robin fairness, process-tree growth, and per-session v2 429 semantics
does_not_establish: vLLM active or queued request counts
scope.latency_label: CPU HF local decode, not the deployed GPU bound

production_path.service: one locally started FastAPI process with live routes enabled
production_path.decoder: the real MOSS decoder through the production LiveServiceRuntime path
production_path.backend: explicit local Hugging Face model directory
production_path.audio: real human speech replayed at wall-clock rate

frame_geometry.source: read at run time from both local and read-only deployed /api/live/descriptor endpoints
frame_geometry.comparison: all deployed bound fields must match exactly before capture begins

latency.aggregation: compute each session independently; the run value is the maximum session p95
latency.reporting_rule: record p50, p95, max, and the full per-session arrays under the CPU/HF-local label; never present this figure as deployed GPU latency
latency.basis: 10.0 seconds preserves ticket #3's pre-existing ceiling because the one-to-eight-session CPU/HF screening matrix and a 600-second selected-bound soak were unmeasured when this profile was frozen. It is deliberately wide headroom, not evidence of a tight CPU bound. The verdict must also compare its observed maximum session p95 against the prior two-session CPU observation of 0.248 seconds and state the resulting headroom.

memory.reporting_rule: record local process-tree RSS samples; missing GPU metrics do not fail this local profile and must remain explicitly unclaimed
memory.basis: 4 GiB is a safety ceiling for an unmeasured selected-bound CPU/HF soak, not a claim that normal growth should approach it. Zero OOM or accelerator errors is the tight memory safety criterion.

fairness.evidence: full canonical_processed dispatch order and per-session counts

required_behavior: one saturated session receives retryable HTTP 429 without terminal failure or sequence consumption
a concurrently active peer accepts a frame while the saturated session is refused
the refused frame succeeds after capacity is released

integrity.overload: all rendered text and canonical_processed events retain only their own session's distinct speech marker while the backpressure case runs
integrity.reconnect: after each observer reconnects with its prior cursor, its replayed events and snapshot contain no other session's marker

selection_rule.rule: record every 1/2/4/8-session screening result, then choose the largest candidate whose screening run passes latency, local-memory, fairness, and integrity gates; only that chosen candidate may enter the 600-second soak
selection_rule.overload_role: the two-session overload run proves per-session retryable 429 and text isolation; it does not select the normal concurrency bound

raw_arrays: HTTP frame responses including session id and retry outcome
observer reconnect cursors and returned events
required_recorded_metrics: local CPU/HF canonical decode real-time factor from canonical_processed events
evidence_requirements.required_negative_statement: The CPU/HF-local result does not measure deployed GPU p95 lag, GPU memory, or GPU utilisation.
